reviews.text:
I have a dog and this is his favorite store! Here we get food, toys and help with clipping paws, and so local!

It is part of Lille CC Vest which is a slightly quieter version of CC Vest. It is quite lovely

Recommend to take a look if you have an animal lover!

Came to complain a little about fish I had bought that died after 4 days.. Took a long time before the staff even said hello, made a lot of excuses about the fish, and in the middle of the conversation she goes to stand at the cash register instead and starts serving a new customer even though there was staff at the cash register. Was not interested in coming up with a solution for the fish I came to complain about. There were also a lot of dead fish in the aquariums in the store. Will not shop there again. Are there other aquarium stores...
Very nice shop! Sofie always gives extremely good service, the only reason I come back, so I recommend asking for her!!
They are amazing! They have, specially the manager, have tons of knowledge. Very helpful and friendly. I do recommend buying the supplies for your pet from this store.

If you need something that crawls, crawls, swims, flies or walks on two, four or more legs, then Buddy at CC Vest is the place for you. This store has everything you need to complete your animal kingdom – from fancy machines to filter the water for your fish, to fur care that makes your dog shine like a star. They even have an impressive selection of rabbits, mice and rats that look like they have their own Tik-Tok account. All this packed into a store that can almost be described as a zoo with shorter queues and better air quality.

But today I got a whole new reason to prefer Buddy at CC-vest. I was starstruck when I was served by Ole Paus himself who runs the store! Yes, that Ole Paus – my childhood hero from the magical 1970s when I established my interest in aquariums, spent all my weekly allowance in his legendary store in Akersgata, AS Aquarium. It remains one of my fondest memories, even though the fish died and the learning curve could have been steeper.

Believe it or not, I still read Ole Paus' masterpiece, IPC Store Akvariebok, which has been my faithful companion throughout my freshwater adventure

Buddy is not just a store - it's a tribute to animals, aquarium art and nostalgia, perfectly curated by a man who is, to me, a living legend.
The only negative is the small selection of cat snacks.
Nice service and patient service. Well used to dogs, and a lot to contribute.
At Buddy CC West you feel really welcome. Both of the people who were at work were incredibly service-minded, nice and very knowledgeable about dogs. We will visit here again🔥😍 …
Thank you very much for your help Sandra, we are very happy. Thank you
